T1.note: unit + demos + non-Docker integration; floor = measured minus ~2% slack. Raise when suites grow (ratchet up, never down without a PLAN.md note).

T2.note: Docker-dependent integration (tdd/integration/services/execution). If Docker is unreachable these skip wholesale - the floor makes that a hard failure.

T3.note: e2e quick tier (tdd/e2e -m 'not slow'). Known exclusion (R4, stated not silent): the 21 @slow e2e tests (control layer, real card execution, graph pipeline full-stack) run in NO tier and have no floor here - they need the compose e2e stack the legacy runner cannot host. Host-runnable via the scripts/test slow lane; they enter dogfood CI at Phase 12.4/12.5 when ephemeral execution can host them. Tier selections are single-sourced in scripts/run_tier.py.
